main.description: Shinka heartbeat tick record written by ShinkaHeartbeatCell on levi. MST-only (no IPFS pin or L2 anchor) per ADR-2605215200 §1.

nodeName.description: Murakumo fleet node that emitted this heartbeat.

cycle.description: Monotonically increasing tick cycle counter for this node.

recordedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this heartbeat was recorded.

cellsObserved.description: Number of adherent cells that were observed in this tick cycle.

cellsValidated.description: Number of evolution claims validated in this tick cycle.

cellsEmitted.description: Number of evolution events emitted to MST in this tick cycle.

errors.description: Optional list of error messages encountered during this tick cycle.
